title: Global DI telltales: re-enable dict -1 and dict 1 globals at 2x/4x and clean up definitions

telltales.name: g-di-dict-neg1-match-short-term-threshold-exceeded
reasons: Re-enable: remove the impossible condition (dictionary = -99) added for the os_version release (CHNGE-6580). Dictionaries have recovered from the re-key (go confirmed 5 Nov, re-checked 10 Nov).
Velocity threshold: 1x (breach only, no ratio) → 2x.
Structure: OR pairs, EXISTS rows and duplicate rows replaced by single boolean rows, all ANDed. Same intent, nothing can widen the match.

telltales.name: g-di-unknown-signature-exceeding-short-term-threshold
reasons: Re-enable: remove the impossible condition (dictionary = -99) added for the os_version release (CHNGE-6580). Dictionaries have recovered from the re-key (go confirmed 5 Nov, re-checked 10 Nov).
Velocity threshold: 1x to under 4x → 2x to under 4x.
Band: Covers 2x to 4x; 6762 covers 4x and above.
Structure: OR pairs, EXISTS rows and duplicate rows replaced by single boolean rows, all ANDed. Same intent, nothing can widen the match.
Note: this telltale has immediate_non_legit = true (unchanged), so the threshold change directly reduces sessions marked non-legit.

telltales.name: g-di-unknown-signature-exceeding-4x-short-term-threshold
reasons: Re-enable: remove the impossible condition (dictionary = -99) added for the os_version release (CHNGE-6580). Dictionaries have recovered from the re-key (go confirmed 5 Nov, re-checked 10 Nov).
Bug fix: the di_success group was AND (true AND "1"), which can never match. It fired 0 times on 368 eligible sessions (1–20 Oct).
Structure: OR pairs, EXISTS rows and duplicate rows replaced by single boolean rows, all ANDed. Same intent, nothing can widen the match.
Note: this telltale has immediate_non_legit = true (unchanged), so the threshold change directly reduces sessions marked non-legit.

telltales.telltale_description: NAME NOT CHANGED DUE TO DOWNSTREAM DEPS - RATIO IS 4x NOT 2x
reasons: Re-enable: remove the impossible condition (dictionary = -99) added for the os_version release (CHNGE-6580). Dictionaries have recovered from the re-key (go confirmed 5 Nov, re-checked 10 Nov).
Velocity threshold: 2x to under 4x → 4x.

telltales.name: g-di-dict-1-match-short-term-threshold-exceeded-1x
telltales.telltale_description: NAME NOT CHANGED DUE TO DOWNSTREAM DEPS - RATIO IS 2x NOT 1x
reasons: Re-enable: remove the impossible condition (dictionary = -99) added for the os_version release (CHNGE-6580). Dictionaries have recovered from the re-key (go confirmed 5 Nov, re-checked 10 Nov).
Velocity threshold: 1x (breach only, no ratio) → 2x.

Brave condition removed: it was added years ago when Brave landed in the low dictionaries. Today only 0.37% of Brave sessions breach 2x (6.5% for other browsers) and Brave is 1.3% of dict -1/1 traffic (5.8% for others). The exclusion no longer prevents false positives (data since 5 Nov, 2% sample).

Exclude Bank of America Beacon Workforce ATM K4: production keys with shared or high-repeat devices (bank ATMs, chat prompts) that breach velocity on legitimate use (e.g. BofA Workforce ATM K4: 77% of its dict 3 traffic at ≥2x).
Add include g-global-telltales-enabled so the global kill switch applies (it was missing).
Structure: OR pairs, EXISTS rows and duplicate rows replaced by single boolean rows, all ANDed. Same intent, nothing can widen the match.
